title: 第六章 大哥第七章 祁嘉城第八章 选拨上
content_zh:
草药疗效非常之好，半月之后，秦凤鸣的爷爷就已然能下床慢慢走动，家人见此，自是万分高兴，之后的日子又慢慢归于了平静。
秦凤鸣有时和村中伙伴一起上山玩耍，间或打些干柴，采集野果。
但在无人之时，秦凤鸣便会拿出那小葫芦，偷偷把玩。
那葫芦除表面光彩耀眼，十分引人，毫无其他异样，对此，秦凤鸣极为不解。
这日午后，秦家村入村的山道之上，突然出现了十数名骑高头大马之人，这些人却均是精壮青年，最后一匹马上驮着一些货物。
正在山坡之上玩耍的秦凤鸣见此，立即与伙伴停止了嬉闹。
面露困惑之色的看着来人。
秦家村地处偏僻，难得来如此多外乡之人。
片刻功夫，那队人马就来到了众人近前。
当先一人跳下马，仔细打量众孩童，突然，一眼看到秦凤鸣，登时面露惊喜之色道：
“小三子，三弟，不认得我了，我是大哥秦祥。”
“大哥秦祥？”
秦凤鸣听到此言，登时大愣。
大哥走时，他才七八岁间，印象之中，大哥瘦瘦的，皮肤有些黑，个头和父亲略矮一些。
但面前之人，高大威猛，气宇轩昂，面色红润。
仔细打量之下，秦凤鸣才依稀分辨出一些原来大哥的样子。
立马跳下山坡，紧跑几步，一把将大哥手捉住，用力摇着，面上露出惊喜之色。
秦祥抚摸秦凤鸣头顶，面上洋溢着兴奋之色：“三弟，咱爹娘，爷爷、奶奶现在可都安好？”
“他们都很好，咱们快回家，奶奶和娘经常念叨你呢。”
见到大哥。

秦凤鸣虽心中不解大哥因何变成了如此模样，但面上笑容不减。
今日秦洪并未进山，而是在家中整理打猎用具，突然听闻长子归来，顿时大喜，与家人赶紧来到院门外。
“父母、爷爷、奶奶在上，不孝之子秦祥给您磕头了。”
远远瞧见父母等人，秦祥忙扔掉缰绳，快步跑上前，跪在地上给众人见礼。
秦洪父子满含热泪，将秦祥扶起。
拉着秦祥进入院中。
随秦祥而来的十数名青年极为规矩，在秦祥吩咐之下，将马上物品卸下。
这时众人才知，马上所驮货品，是一些布匹、粮食、酒肉。
正在众人言谈之时，族长听到消息，带着一些族中长辈也自来到秦家。
如此热闹之事，秦洪自是吩咐众人，用秦祥所带的粮食，肉食盛摆筵宴，以款待村中乡亲。
酒席间，秦祥这才叙述这两年参军经历，一听之下，顿让众人惊喜不已。
原来，秦祥参军后，分在一名叫李炳堂的军官手下当差，李炳堂时任祁嘉城一名千夫长。
经两个月训练，李炳堂见秦祥十分机灵、聪明、肯吃苦，心中欢喜之下，将之提拔当了自己亲卫兵，并亲自指点秦祥练武。
content_en:
The herbal medicine was very effective. After half a month, Qin Fengming's grandfather was able to get out of bed and walk around slowly. The family was very happy when they saw this, and the days after that slowly returned to peace.
Qin Fengming sometimes goes up to the mountains to play with his friends in the village, and sometimes collects dry firewood and collects wild fruits.
But when no one is around, Qin Fengming will take out the small gourd and play with it secretly.
Apart from the dazzling and attractive surface, the gourd had no other abnormalities. Qin Fengming was extremely puzzled by this.
In the afternoon of this day, on the mountain road leading into Qinjia Village, a dozen people riding tall horses suddenly appeared. These people were all strong young men, and the last horse was carrying some goods.
Qin Fengming, who was playing on the hillside, saw this and immediately stopped playing with his friends.
He looked at the visitor with confusion on his face.
Qinjia Village is located in a remote area, and it is rare for so many people from other places to come here.
In a moment, the team of people came to the crowd.
The first person jumped off the horse and looked at the children carefully. Suddenly, when he saw Qin Fengming, he said with a look of surprise:
"Younger, third brother, you don't recognize me anymore. I am the eldest brother Qin Xiang."
"Brother Qin Xiang?"
Qin Fengming was stunned when he heard this.
When his eldest brother left, he was only seven or eight years old. In his impression, his eldest brother was thin, with dark skin, and slightly shorter than his father.
But the person in front of him was tall, mighty, majestic, and had a ruddy complexion.
After looking carefully, Qin Fengming could vaguely distinguish some of his original eldest brother's appearance.
He immediately jumped down the hillside, ran a few steps, grabbed the eldest brother's hand, and shook it hard, with a look of surprise on his face.
Qin Xiang stroked Qin Fengming's head, his face filled with excitement: "Third brother, are our parents, grandpa, and grandma okay now?"
"They are all fine. Let's go home quickly. Grandma and mother often talk about you."
Meet big brother.
Although Qin Fengming was puzzled as to why his eldest brother became like this, the smile on his face did not diminish.
Qin Hong did not go into the mountains today, but was packing hunting equipment at home. Suddenly he heard that his eldest son had returned. He was overjoyed and hurried out of the courtyard with his family.
"My parents, grandpa, and grandma are above me. Qin Xiang, my unfilial son, kowtows to you."
Seeing his parents and others from a distance, Qin Xiang hurriedly threw away the reins, ran forward quickly, knelt on the ground to greet everyone.
Qin Hong and his son lifted Qin Xiang up with tears in their eyes.
Pull Qin Xiang into the courtyard.
The dozen young men who came with Qin Xiang were extremely well-behaved and unloaded their belongings under Qin Xiang's instructions.
At this time, everyone realized that the goods carried on the horse were some cloth, grain, wine and meat.
While everyone was talking, the clan leader heard the news and came to the Qin family with some elders of the clan.
With such a lively event, Qin Hong ordered everyone to prepare a banquet using the food and meat brought by Qin Xiang to entertain the villagers.
During the banquet, Qin Xiang recounted his experience in joining the army in the past two years. Everyone was pleasantly surprised when he heard this.
It turned out that after Qin Xiang joined the army, he was assigned to work under an officer named Li Bingtang. Li Bingtang was then a captain of thousands in Qijia City.
After two months of training, Li Bingtang saw that Qin Xiang was very clever, intelligent and willing to endure hardships. He was so happy that he promoted him to his personal guard and personally taught Qin Xiang how to practice martial arts.
